title: Require Swooper Map Script Realization Topology
forbids: an open Swooper map-script runtime or proof cabinet that can absorb host tooling, reusable contracts, or unrelated product behavior
why: The deployable mod application owns one exact in-engine realization: native adapter, setup capture, entrypoint, compiler, and their bounded runtime proofs.
remediate: Move reusable contracts to packages, product definition to the Swooper plugin, and retain only the admitted map-script realization members here.
message: The Swooper map-script realization must preserve its exact closed topology.
